_comment: Hand-curation state for pool_hl, kept OUTSIDE the pool because pool_hl
itself is gitignored and fully regenerated by curate_team_pool.py — a
regen used to silently restore every team benched here (2026-07-29).
Keyed on the CORE HASH, which is _short_hash(_core_key(species)) and is
the trailing field of the generated filename. The hash is index-free, so
these drops survive a popularity re-ranking that renumbers the pool.
Drops are applied AFTER the top-N popularity cut, so the pool shrinks by
the number of drops rather than backfilling with never-benched teams.
Raise --hl-size if you want the slots back.
class 'illegal': rejected by the SERVER, which is the authoritative
validator. validate_teams.js gen9ou is only a proxy — gen9oulongtimer is
a PokeAgent-custom format absent from standard formats.ts, so it catches
standard OU bans but misses longtimer extras. These teams validate CLEAN
locally and still get rejected on the ladder, burning rotation slots.
class 'benched': legal, but measured as the wrong tool for the matchup.
